citation: herdr v0.8.0 src/detect/manifest/tests.rs, the tests of herdr's bundled manifests; each case names the test it came from. Codex cases follow the catalog manifest Muster vendors (2026.09.23.1) where it deliberately changed v0.8.0's verdict; each such case says so.
why: herdr's manifests are data written against herdr's engine, so the only evidence that this engine reads them the same way is herdr's own verdicts on the screens its authors wrote them for. Each case is a screen, a title and an OSC 9 payload in, and the state, deciding rule, visibility and skip flag out - the whole of what the publish loop acts on. `screen` is the region input as herdr's test passed it, not wrapped by screen_text. Where herdr's test asserted a state but not the deciding rule (the Devin idle, working and blocked screens other than the live footer and narrow welcome), the rule is this engine's reading of herdr's manifest, and a re-pin that moves it is worth a look rather than a rewrite.

cases.name: codex: ordinary text is the idle fallback
cases.why: A known agent whose screen matches no rule is idle, and not visibly so - which is what lets the loop hold a working-to-idle change until it is confirmed rather than trusting a screen that merely stopped saying anything. (known_agent_no_match_defaults_to_idle_fallback)

given.screen: ordinary prompt text

cases.name: devin: the welcome prompt box is idle
cases.why: Devin's idle chrome is a prompt box between two rules, so reading it depends on the prompt_box_body region cutting where herdr's did. (devin_manifest_detects_idle_working_and_blocked_states)

cases.name: devin: a labelled top border still bounds the prompt box
cases.why: The live footer draws a label into the rule above the prompt ('(bypass permissions on)'), and a rule with a label is still a rule - is_horizontal_rule accepts one after three dashes. (devin_manifest_detects_idle_working_and_blocked_states)

cases.name: devin: the welcome screen on a narrow pane is idle
cases.why: A narrow pane wraps the welcome text and the model footer, which is the case the welcome_prompt_footer rule exists for. The braille art in the banner must not read as a spinner. (devin_manifest_detects_idle_working_and_blocked_states)

cases.name: claude: a braille spinner in the title is working
cases.why: Claude Code animates its title with a braille spinner while it works, which is the cheapest and surest working signal it gives. (claude_osc_title_braille_prefix_is_working)

cases.name: claude: the static star in the title is idle
cases.why: When it stops, Claude Code's title settles on ✳. (claude_osc_title_static_prefix_is_idle)

cases.name: claude: progress 4;3 alone is not working
cases.why: Claude Code leaves OSC 9;4 progress at 4;3 while it waits for permission, so that value cannot mean working on its own; with no other evidence the agent is the idle fallback. (claude_osc_progress_4_3_alone_does_not_force_working)

cases.name: codex: a plain title is idle
cases.why: A title with neither spinner nor Action Required is Codex at rest. (codex_osc_title_plain_is_idle) herdr's catalog manifest codex 2026.09.23.1, which Muster vendors, dropped the osc_title_idle rule, so a plain title is now the idle fallback rather than visible idle; the state is unchanged.
